text:
Lena: Quick idea — 30s lunchtime tic-tac-toe tourney on the breakroom whiteboard? Winner gets bragging rights + a mystery cookie :cookie:
devops-bot: Poll created: React with :x: to play as X, :o: to play as O. Matchups posted at 12:05.
Omar: I'm down. X or O? flip a coin for me :coin:
Priya: O for me, and I will bring markers.
Benji: If I win I demand a dramatic victory lap.
Sophie: Adding a tiny paper crown to the prize pool.
Jules: can we livestream it to the zoom room for dramatic commentary? :joy:
Lena: love the crown idea. streaming mild commentary is allowed. no professional sports contracts.
Omar: bringing snack bribery (mini pretzels) to sway judges.
Priya: who are the judges though. I nominate Sophie + Benji?
Benji: Accepting judging duties but reserve the right to be biased toward poetic moves.
Sophie: I'll judge if someone promises not to use advanced tic-tac-toe psychology.
Lena: ok judges = Sophie, Benji. Schedule: 12:05 bracket. 8-player max.
devops-bot: Bracket created (8 slots). React to this thread to enter.
Jules: in — entering under the name "Jules the Bold"
Benji: in (but only if my dramatic lap can include a kazoo).
Omar: in. kazoo for the win.
Priya: in. markers secured.
Sophie: spectating + judging, bringing tiny crown.
Lena: couple of one-liners for hype pls. starting example: "May your X's be sharp and your O's be chilled."
Benji: "I put the X in eXcellence." :sunglasses:
Omar: "O the places you'll block."
Priya: "May the best tic-tac-toe artist prevail."
Sophie: :thumbsup: these are solid.
Jules: also printing a 30s timer — enforced.
Lena: last call to enter! (bracket will lock at 12:02)
devops-bot: Bracket locked. Players: Jules, Benji, Omar, Priya. Matches scheduled 12:05-12:20.
Benji: may the cookie be ever in your favor.
Omar: whoever loses buys the winner coffee next week?
Priya: deal.
Lena: love it. ok see you at lunch — bring your best one-liners and kazoo solos. :tada:
